notes.title: Fake Signals V1.02 Uptate: Optimized Headshot Rate and Accuracy!
notes.content:
Dear courageous assassins, we have now conducted the second update for the game. 
The specific details are as follows:

[b][olist]
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented achieving 100% accuracy in levels 3-5.
[*] Optimized the calculation method for headshot rate and accuracy within the game.
[/olist]
[/b]Thank you for your continued attention and support. 
We are committed to providing you with a better gaming experience.

notes.title: Fake Signals V1.01 Update: Difficulty Option Added!
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow assassins! Thank you for your patience! 
Today, we bring you an exciting new update. Get ready to gain all the details below!

[b][olist][*] Added a difficulty option: "Normal Mode"
[list]

[*] The protagonist can withstand two hits.
[*] The protagonist can acquire more weapon resources.
[*] Adjusted the number of surveillance cameras compared to Hard Mode.
[*] Adjusted enemy shooting accuracy and detection range compared to Hard Mode.
[/list]
[*] Added two emails: " Hide from Enemies" and " Advantages of Lights Off".
[*] Added an "Effect Sound" setting.
[*] Fixed the issue where the volume couldn't be completely muted.
[*] Fixed the issue where in Level 1-8, during the cutscene, the protagonist was locked and unable to move.[/olist][/b]
Thanks for your attention and support! Feel free to share your thoughts and ideas anytime. We're all ears and ready to make your gaming experience even more amazing!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161430/_/
